intent: Independently review the frozen Qwen3.8 Flash model comparison before execution without changing prompts, cases, labels or scoring.
verdict_scope: Experimental integrity and readiness to execute the exact frozen comparison; no claim of benchmark acceptance or release readiness.

changed_factors.behavioral: Target model identifier only, from qwen3.5-flash to qwen3.8-flash.
changed_factors.operational: Configurable bounded workers and shared exact-request judge cache; source and baseline evidence remain immutable.
changed_factors.tutor: Reuse all 183 saved frozen candidate07 baseline outputs and generate corresponding candidate requests with identical initial messages, temperature 0.3, max_tokens 100, thinking false, and the same production JSON repair. Reevaluate both arms symmetrically with the currently installed calibrated evaluator.
changed_factors.transfer: Reuse 354 saved full candidate02 logical records, corresponding to 348 physical requests. Execute the same frozen handler for the new model with temperature 0, max_tokens 600, thinking false, preserved aliases and own-arm state propagation.
changed_factors.judge: Fixed qwen3.5-flash, temperature 0, max_tokens 8000, thinking true. Original transport and formatting budgets retained.

findings.finding: The original tutor request comparison replaced messages before comparing them, which could conceal message drift.
findings.resolution: matchingRequest now compares the actual initial request after normalizing only the declared model field; repaired requests must equal productionRepair(original.messages), and decoding fields must still match. A structural test rejects changed messages and token budgets.

findings.finding: The unchanged tutor gate expects identical settings and would flag the declared target-model change as an incomparable baseline.
findings.resolution: Only the declared model field is normalized in the temporary gate comparison snapshot. Actual model settings and raw requests remain preserved; all other settings, cases, rubrics and manifests must match.

findings.finding: Transfer candidate summaries initially omitted baseline non-regression and newly failing assertions.
findings.resolution: The driver now records non-regression for every native summary row and nondiagnostic classification row, plus all pass-to-nonpass assertions by case and repetition. Actual target_model is explicit.

findings.finding: The first draft did not pin all legacy rubrics or current calibration provenance.
findings.resolution: The 54-source manifest includes v0/v1 rubric sources, evaluator/runner/gate/analyzer/classification code, source documents, and the v1.3 calibration proposal, independent adoption audit and calibration summary. validate() passed for the exact manifest and every baseline evidence hash.

findings.finding: Concurrent identical judge requests could race to create the same immutable cache file.
findings.resolution: An in-flight promise map shares identical requests; the bounded limiter remains operationally separate from target semantics. Three structural tests passed, including limiter failure recovery.

findings.finding: No case-specific prompt rule, expected-answer lookup or transport request mutation was introduced.
findings.evidence: The wrapper changes deps.env('OAI_MODEL') before the frozen handler builds its own actual request. Original handler, prompts and scoring remain unchanged. Aliases and sequence scheduling use the frozen manifest; resumed transfer evidence is replayed through the handler and compared against saved consumer results.

verification.manifest_validation: Passed, including all pinned source hashes, 183 tutor baseline records and 354 transfer baseline records.
verification.holdout_inspection_by_auditor: No sealed holdout contents inspected. Existing exposed regression sources remain exposed coverage.

reporting_limits: Tutor findings concern exact historical frozen candidate07, which lacks the subsequently approved Guard paragraph in the deployed prompt; do not describe this as validation of the complete current deployed tutor prompt.
Baseline and candidate must be compared on the fresh symmetric evaluator results, not mixed with historical tutor judge scores.
The 354 transfer logical records include dependent aliases; retain unique-input and sequence distinctions when interpreting sample counts.

Sequence arms use the same propagation policy but their later states can differ because earlier model predictions differ. Fixed-input classification and propagated sequence behavior answer different questions.

This audit authorizes execution on integrity grounds only. Missing, malformed, transport and evaluator errors remain visible failures; all native gates and non-regression checks must be assessed after completion.
A model identifier change can include provider implementation and serving differences. Saved baseline reuse is not a simultaneous randomized infrastructure comparison.
